note: A client colour theme for any platform. Copy this file to your project as theme.json, change the colours you need, and delete the entries you do not change. Raw colours are allowed here. Status colours are universal and must not be listed: danger-* (red), warning-* (orange), accent-* and em-green, em-green-core, em-green-soft, em-mint (green). Change the main brand colour and its shades together. Values below are the EncoreMed defaults.
